_comment: Bleakhold Royale: a 20-40 player free-for-all battle royale on its own map. package.py build reads this.
Ids: stock 3.3.5a maps end at 724 and Bleakhold's Emberwing Hollow uses 740, so the map id sits in the
900 block; stock areas end below 5000. `template` fields name existing rows whose values (sounds, music,
liquid types, minimap scale) the new rows copy; the realm's patches may have added rows, so the build
checks every id against the input DBCs and the server SQL and stops on a clash.
instance_type 3 (battleground): each match gets its own BattlegroundMap instance keyed by the player's
battleground id, players cannot walk in (TeleportTo refuses BG maps unless InBattleground()), and the
client shows the battleground score frame. 0 would be one shared world, 1/2 need instance_template +
group rules that fight a 40-player FFA, 4 (arena) blocks long-cooldown spells and caps arena sizes.
zone.set_flags ARENA (0x80) is what makes the whole zone free-for-all PvP: the server's
Player::UpdateArea sets IsInFFAPvPArea from it and the client's GetZonePVPInfo() shows 'arena'.
NO_FLY_ZONE with OUTLAND cleared keeps flying mounts out (the server reads 0x400 as flyable).
light.skybox binds a stock skybox M2 through Light -> LightParams -> LightSkybox (skyboxes never sit in
ADTs). WintergraspSmokySky is the smoky battlefield sky; other verified 3.3.5a choices: DeathSkybox,
DeathClouds, StratholmeSkybox, IceCrownDarkSky, IceCrownScourgeSky, DragonblightScarletSkyBox, Stars.
Alternatives: params_from_map <map id> copies an existing map's default light set (532 = Karazhan's dark
night), params_from_light / params pick exact rows; drop the section for the default sky (Light id 1).
Atmosphere (royale-spec.md 2.4): time_of_day_override 1050 (17:30 light; the client uses value/1440),
zone.template 10 (Duskwood) for its ambience and music. Subzones 5101-5113 copy the zone row, so they
inherit ARENA and NO_FLY_ZONE; the terrain spec (specs/royale_v1.json 'areas') assigns them to chunks.
clear_flags drops every template flag that changes the rules (duels, rest, sanctuary, cities, ghost
revival, indoor-only, outdoor PvP); package.py fails when anything but ARENA, NO_FLY_ZONE and harmless
bits (dbc/config.py HARMLESS_TEMPLATE_FLAGS) remains, and report.txt lists the final flags.
archives.marker_texture: a tiny generated BLP (no game data) packed into patch-Q; the Bleakhold addon
tests it with Texture:SetTexture to know the client has the map patch.
